name: Woods Hole Oceanographic Institution Postdoctoral Scholar Program
amount: At least USD 73,000/year stipend + independent research budget + relocation and health allowances
other_rules: Doctorate no more than 3 years old at the start date (held by appointment)
MIT-WHOI Joint Program students, recent WHOI postdocs and some former WHOI students not eligible
at least two-thirds of the appointment spent at WHOI
notes: Includes biology alongside oceanography, chemistry, engineering, geology, physics, math and marine policy. 2027-28 cycle closes 15 Oct 2026; start between 1 Jan and 1 Oct 2027.
